Element Cattos (alpha 0.13)

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Download NowName your own price

Welcome to the Cattopia National Laboratory's Big Box Of Catto Research™, where you can play around with all sorts of elements in the form of little creatures known as Element Cattos and see how they interact in different conditions and environments. This fun and informative* exhibit is sure to provide hours* of fun for curious schoolchildren and adult nerds alike!* 

*hopefully
*milliseconds if you choose to play with the more radioactive elements
*The CNL is not responsible for any damage, collateral or environmental, caused by experiments in the Box™, including the partial or total destruction of the space-time continuum

This game's development is currently on hold. For a fan-made version with way more features, look for mupsie/ecatto-decomp on git.gay.

If you see a link to this game anywhere other than this page or said repository, DO NOT CLICK IT. IT'S MALWARE. I only advertise my games through trailer/update videos, if ever, and do not make or support malicious programs.

Maybe a community contribution board/service could have people suggest chemical bonds (maybe starting with 2 atom bonds) and have it so if multiple people agree that a chemical is accurate it will get added.
